notes.title: Game Update v5.0.0
notes.content: We've just updated the game to the latest version of the HexWar Engine. This includes various bug fixes and performance improvements!

notes.title: Great Battles of the American Civil War version 3.0.1 Update
notes.content: Fix: Some sound effects not playing following the last update.

notes.title: Great Battles of the American Civil War v3.0.0 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Change: Updated the combat capabilities of Cavalry armed only with Pistols.
[*] Change: Improved A.I. opponent.
[*] Fix: Change: Tutorial two, so all units start in shooting range of each other.
[*] Fix: Change: The unit shoot animations of 'fire and reload' often not working, giving the false impression that units did not, or could not shoot.
[*] Fix: Invalid font selection on some buttons on some platforms.
[*] Fix: Missing some mount dismount button options.
[*] Fix: Some projectile animations not displaying.
[*] Fix: The in-game player message were sometimes cropped at the left edge of the screen.
[*] Fix: Some units blocked from changing formation when playing on some ultra wide screen displays.
[*] Fix: Some screen layout issues.
[/list]
